positions.invalidation: Reduce or close if Canadian core inflation moves decisively above the current near-2% zone while employment and wage growth reaccelerate, or if BoC communication/delivered hikes validate a 2027 path in the mid-3% area. A headline-energy spike without confirmation in core inflation and labor is not sufficient invalidation.
positions.thesis: Receive the 2027 CORRA H/M/U/Z strip. The market prices roughly 84 to 130.5 bp of BoC tightening from a 2.29% overnight rate even though Canadian labor is weak and core inflation is near 2%; the 2027 hike cycle is too aggressive relative to the domestic reaction function.

pms.thesis: Hold the existing 2027 H/M/U/Z CORRA receive, but do not add. The exact strip has normalized materially in our favor to about 3.22 from the 3.40 entry, yet it still averages roughly 91bp above 2.31 cash and March alone remains around 2.945. Canadian underlying inflation near 1.95% and weak domestic labor still do not validate the full 2027 hike path. Brent near 102 and the LNG Canada expansion are genuine upside risks to Canadian inflation and activity, so the remaining edge is smaller and does not justify adding.

positions.thesis: Duration-long / receive MX CRAH27 (paper alias CORRA_2027-03, family locked to CORRA/CRA). Long in this book is long duration with P&L inverted in implied-rate space: profits if Mar-27 implied CORRA falls from 3.13 toward the still-alive near-term path (1m Dec-2026 2.58, 3m Dec-2026 CRAZ26 2.775), not if Canada catches up to SOFR. The 2027 contract is where the unwarranted hiking cycle is concentrated; do not migrate onto SOFR, AONIA, CA-US 2Y, or USDCAD.

pms.thesis: Cash CORRA at 2.30 versus March 2027 at 2.975 still prices 67.5 basis points of Bank of Canada tightening that has not been delivered. That hike arc remains too rich, so the concentrated receive stays the book. The contract has already cheapened from 3.13 and further compression toward cash is the payoff. No add and no second sleeve: size is already the expression of this one path, and US risk stays blocked.

pms.thesis: March 2027 CORRA still trades at 2.975 against 2.30 cash, which prices a large Bank of Canada re-tightening from here. That gap still looks like too much policy path, so staying received on the existing Canadian sleeve is the right expression. The trader room handed over no expanding clips this cycle and new US risk is blocked, so there is no clean second trade to add. Cash at SOFR is the benchmark, not a reason to invent risk.

pms.mandate: Preservation and consistency first. Smaller sizes, high hurdles, quick de-risking. No-trade is valid.
pms.thesis: The book is already flat and the accepted trader-room handoff contains no expanding clips to underwrite. Preservation requires staying out: cash-versus-strip gaps are priced paths, not a standalone edge versus official SOFR charged on shocked risk capital, and new US risk is blocked. I will not originate an independent CA, AU, NZ, EA, or JP expression merely to put capital to work. Sit tight until a markable expanding idea clears the hurdle on a plausible adverse P&L path.
